system.description:
Skullblade Mastery Talent created by Wikia user LilLiteralist.

You treat a Felucian Skullblade as a Simple Weapon (Melee) instead of as an Exotic Weapon (Melee). Additionally, you gain a +1 bonus to attack rolls with a Felucian Skullblade. This Talent counts as the Weapon Focus (Felucian Skullblade) feat for the purpose of satisfying prerequisites.

If you also have the Weapon Focus (Simple Weapons) feat, the attack bonus provided by this Talent does not stack with the attack bonus provided by Weapon Focus (Simple Weapons).

prerequisite.text: a member of The Felucian Shamans
